RE: Account ID: ACC-655178

Dear Mr. Abbott,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the account with Account ID: ACC-655178, we acknowledge your request for a review of the account information. You have disputed the account as potentially containing inaccurate information, specifically citing concerns related to identity theft.

Pursuant to the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), 15 USC 1681e(b), we are required to provide you with a written validation of the debt. As the account is currently listed as charged-off on 2024-02-15, with a last payment date of 2025-06-14, and a current balance of $724.98, we will provide you with a validation of the debt. This will include information regarding the original creditor, Premier Financial Group, and the amount owed.

We will conduct an investigation into the accuracy of the account information and will respond to your dispute in accordance with the FCRA, 15 USC 1681i. If, upon investigation, we determine that the account information is inaccurate, we will take the necessary steps to correct the information.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this account further if you believe the validation provided does not accurately reflect the debt. You may also request that we provide additional documentation or information regarding the account.

Sincerely,

Vanguard Debt Services
